messages.subject: Checkalleles
parts:
Dear Prof Broman, good day sir. Please, how do I remove alleles outputted from the checkalleles function?

checkAlleles(namthis, threshold=5)
           marker chr index diff.in.max.LOD
1885  S2_64909113   2   775       11.627731
3506  S4_34716001   4   320       15.476025
5032  S6_15691340   6   146        8.986237
5092  S6_27696013   6   206       13.540403
5669  S6_60806527   6   783        8.272040
8286 S10_29106771  10   404       23.627433

And please what are the implications of allowing them to be in the data?

Thanks.

Marcus.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Checkalleles
parts:
Take a look at Chapter 3 of the R/qtl book (http://rqtl.org/book).

I'd use geno.crosstab() to study the genotypes for the flagged marker and surrounding ones and try to figure out whether there's really a problem and what needs to be fixed.

If there are problems with the coding of alleles, you want to fix them rather than leave the markers in the data in that way.

karl
